featured_reviews.name: Khushnaaz Anklesaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent visit at Florien Walkeshwar was deeply disappointing, especially because it was such a stark contrast to the excellent experience I had at this same branch last year.
To start positively, the therapist who performed my Korean Hair Spa treatment was good. Unfortunately, everything surrounding the treatment made what should have been a relaxing experience feel uncomfortable and stressful.
I was assigned a "VIP room" that featured translucent glass panels with a few transparent strips. As a woman, I found this completely inappropriate for a spa treatment requiring privacy. I was expected to change and spend over one hour in this room while male staff frequently moved around outside and the floor was full of male and female customers. The setup made me feel uncomfortable and self-conscious rather than relaxed.
What was particularly frustrating is that I raised my concerns before the treatment began, but was told there was no alternative room available. While I understand operational constraints, customer privacy should never be compromised because of scheduling issues.
The discomfort worsened towards the end of the service when multiple male staff members began knocking on the door while the therapist was still completing the treatment. I genuinely worried someone might enter before I was ready. No customer    (especially a woman) should feel that level of anxiety during a luxury spa service.
The room was also unsuitable for relaxation. It was not soundproof, and spa music was drowned out by loud conversations, customers on phones, blow dryers, and general salon noise and their own music outside the spa room. Bright white salon lights shone through the top transparent glass, making it even harder to relax.
There were also smaller details that fell short of expectations. During my consultation, the staff member assessing my hair had hands that smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. So much for a premium experience costing close to INR 6000.
I shared this feedback at the billing counter and was offered a complimentary manicure/pedicure voucher, which I appreciate. However, it does not change the fact that I spent much of the treatment feeling uncomfortable and unable to relax.
What makes this especially disappointing is that my previous visit last year was exceptional. Unfortunately, this experience left me feeling that my privacy, comfort, and overall experience as a female customer were not given the consideration they deserved. For the price charged and the premium image the salon projects, that is simply unacceptable.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent visit to our Walkeshwar outlet.

We are sorry to learn that your experience did not meet your expectations. At Florian Hurel Hair Couture & Spa, we strive to create an environment where every guest feels comfortable, cared for, and able to enjoy their services with complete peace of mind. We regret that aspects of your visit left you feeling otherwise.

Your feedback has been carefully reviewed and shared with our management team. We value all guest perspectives and continuously assess our facilities, service protocols, and guest experience standards to ensure they align with the level of service we aim to provide.

Please be assured that your concerns have been taken seriously and have been escalated internally. We are reviewing our privacy measures, operational protocols, and service standards to ensure a more comfortable and appropriate experience for all guests.

We appreciate you bringing your experience to our attention and thank you for your continued feedback.

Warm regards,
Team Florian Hurel Hair Couture & Spa

featured_reviews.review_text:
My husband and I got pedicures and I got a gel manicure. My pedicure (by Akash) was nice and relaxing, with a good polish finish.  My gel french manicure with extra art (by Dipali) was done well (see picture).

I liked that I could contact the salon via WhatsApp to ask questions and make the booking, especially since I was visiting from abroad.  The inside of the salon was very nicely designed (included pedicure chairs with massage), albeit small with an inconvenient entryway (directly on a busy street), and the staff was very friendly (offered us coffee and tea).

One major issue I had was that I had specifically requested (and the salon confirmed) a pedicure with paraffin wax for my husband but they did not have it available when we showed up.  They only told us after we had already been seated in the pedicure chairs.  It felt misleading given that my husband would not have come if we had known this service was not available and the alternative pedicure was not a good substitute for the paraffin wax pedicure.

Overall the quality of the services were good but very overpriced.  There are too many great options in Mumbai (with better pricing) for me to return to this salon.
